3::nonhuman biological mutant, no humanoid::, tall compact heavy soft-bodied organism like a folded fluid-filled mantle, broad closed pale desaturated teal tissue pouch hanging between four thick fingerlike supporting feet, small recessed eyeless face slit turned left. Layered dark blue-gray skin folds protect the front, a few pale ivory calluses at joints, one old cloth cuff caught at a limb. Body looks heavy and restrained, all feet grounded, neutral idle stance. Sparse soft reflections, broad quiet shapes. No water elemental, no humanoid armor, no glowing blue veins, dripping particles, translucent puddle, fantasy spear or gore.

One complete full-body battle character illustration on a truly transparent background.

2::single subject, full body, side view, facing left, looking left, orthographic projection, eye-level camera, no perspective, neutral idle standing pose::, entire head and all feet visible, supporting feet on one horizontal line, no action, no movement, no attack, plain pale gray background, character isolated with generous margins, centered in portrait canvas.

Hand painted Japanese anime game enemy sprite, strong readable silhouette, large coherent matte color masses, selective expressive linework, restrained chromatic grays with small vivid accents. Not photorealistic, not 3D, no airbrushed haze.

0.9::quasarcake::, 0.5::rella::, 0.4::gomzi::, 0.3::piromizu::

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
